calculation_rule.pooled_statistics: Flatten records[].norms, retain every finite numeric value, compute mu_stage1 as the pooled arithmetic mean, and compute median_stage1_norm as the pooled median.
calculation_rule.reference_points: c_T_ref = 1.00; c_A_ref = c_T_ref - grid_step; c_H_ref = c_T_ref + grid_step.
calculation_rule.runtime_anchor_handling: Bitwise-copy rho_by_anchor; do not recompute or move anchors at runtime.

single_prompt_limitation: The Stage 1 decode-only full1000 evidence uses 1000 random vectors on one harmful prompt; it only contextualizes the fixed reference points and does not support outcome optimization or broader behavioral generalization.
